name: AlgoAlpha — 7-email Hormozi $100M Leads template (per video retainer + 30 percent lifetime commission)
target: Crypto + trading content creators (YouTube, TradingView authors, Substacks). {company} = channel/brand. {personal_hook} populated by personal_hook_worker.py — only required on step 1.
voice_notes: Hormozi $100M Leads templates verbatim structure. Step 1 = 'Are you open?' + personalised hook (the prospect's most recent video). Step 4 = 'Are you busy?' Problem/Solution. NO apostrophes, em-dashes, quotes, word-hyphens. Required: {company} (greeting falls back to channel name when no personal name is parseable); {personal_hook} on step 1 only. {retainer_quote} + {retainer_math} are derived merges (always present, computed at send time).
offer_notes: Lead offer = a flat per video retainer STACKED on top of the existing 30 percent lifetime commission. The retainer is personalized PER INFLUENCER at send time by sequences/algoalpha_offer.py from prospects.audience_size: 4 USD per 1,000 subscribers per video, rounded to the nearest 50, floor 200 USD, cap 5,000 USD (cap reached ~1.25M), max 4 paid videos per month (bounds monthly exposure; framed in copy as opportunity, e.g. up to 4,200 USD a month). Math favors us: break-even ~0.023 percent of expected views converting; commission only pays on collected revenue. INTERNAL ONLY — the copy states the resulting number as a locked offer and NEVER reveals the rate, the math, or the audience figure next to the quote; we calculate on our end. Quoted through the {retainer_quote} (inline clause) and {retainer_math} (offer paragraph, step 3) merge fields; unknown or sub-10k audiences fall back to range language (200 to 5,000 USD, sized to your channel) that asks for the channel link. Reference points: 50k=200, 100k=400, 250k=1,000, 500k=2,000, 1M=4,000. Proof points held constant: 14.1M TradingView chart adds, 75k paying traders, Editor Choice badge x2.
schedule_doc: delay_days = gap from prior step. 0,2,2,3,4,7,10 = day 0,2,4,7,11,18,28.

variants._ab_note: STEP-1 A/B STARTED 2026-06-22. A-side (this linked variant) = rate-curiosity opener ('{company} rate', reply for your locked per-video number). B-side (inline on the algoalpha step-1 sequence_step) = cash-lead opener ('a paid feature for {company}', leads with 'we pay creators a flat fee plus 30% lifetime commission'). Tests curiosity-rate vs direct-cash framing; same {personal_hook}/{retainer_quote} merges, same char rules (no apostrophes/dashes/quotes/word-hyphens). Runner E1 split 50/50. Read: py scripts/ab-status.py --profile algoalpha. [[aureon-givefirst-ab]]
variants.subject: {company} rate
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

{personal_hook}

Here is something useful either way. Reply with your channel link and I will send back the exact retainer we would pay {company} per video, a flat number, locked, win or lose.

How it works once you have the number: you feature AlgoAlpha in a video, we pay you {retainer_quote} up front whether your audience signs up or not, and you keep 30 percent lifetime commission on every paid signup you send, every month they stay.

For context, we are AlgoAlpha. 14.1 million chart adds on TradingView, 75,000 paying traders, Editor Choice badge twice. The product converts, so the commission stacks on top of the cash you already banked.

Reply with your channel link and I send your number.

variants.subject: your number
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Quick follow up. The number for {company} still stands, reply with your channel link and I send your exact per video retainer back.

The part worth knowing before you ask: that retainer is paid up front whether a single viewer signs up or not, so there is zero performance risk on your side. The 30 percent lifetime commission rides on top for the ones who do sign up, every month they stay.

Want your number?

variants.subject: 14k before any signup
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

What this actually pays out.

{retainer_math}

One creator partner last quarter, a channel in the 250k to 1M range, posted 4 videos and banked 14,000 USD in retainer before a single signup cleared. The commission stacked on top of that. Average paid signup spends 247 USD in year one, so your 30 percent is about 74 USD per signup per year, and it keeps paying as long as they stay.

Reply with your channel link and the same math runs for {company} with your real number.

variants.subject: sponsor money runs out
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Me again. This is the fourth email so I will keep it short.

Problem: a one off sponsorship pays you once, then the money stops, and you carry the risk if it does not convert.

Solution: we pay a retainer per video up front, so you are paid like a sponsor but with no conversion risk, and the 30 percent lifetime commission keeps paying every month a subscriber stays. The same audience you would rent to a sponsor one time, you get paid for up front and then keep collecting on.

Reply with your channel link and I send the exact retainer for {company}.

variants.subject: {company}, yes or no
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

If we paid {company} {retainer_quote} up front, win or lose, with nothing charged to you ever, plus 30 percent lifetime commission on every signup, would you say yes?

A clear yes or no both work.

variants.subject: a mockup for you
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

Whether {company} takes the retainer or not, here is something useful.

Reply with your channel link and I will put together a one page mockup of the custom indicator we would build and brand for your audience, then send it over. No call attached to it.

The retainer and the 30 percent commission stay open whenever you want them.

variants.subject: closing your file
variants.body:
Hey {greeting},

I am closing your partner file at AlgoAlpha for now, so this is the last one from me.

If the timing is off for {company}, I get it. If the offer is off, tell me what would land and I will listen.

Either way the door stays open. Reply with your channel link anytime and I send your exact per video retainer, plus the 30 percent lifetime commission, no call needed.
